outputs.explanation: Panel A includes bar graphs (Nuclear, Cytosolic, Mitochondrial fraction quantifications) presented as mean ± SD with error bars, but no individual data points are overlaid on the bars, despite N=4 samples per group being stated.
Panel B consists of immunoelectron micrographs, not a plot of averaged data, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.
Panel C is a western blot image showing bands across lanes; it is not a plot of averaged/aggregated data, so this check does not apply.
Panel D is a western blot image showing protein bands under different treatment conditions; it is not a plot of averaged data, so this check does not apply.
